rows.title: Ten times the menu
rows.plant: Three lines at ten times the menu price, a service charge, and a QR to a personal UPI ID.
rows.headline: This bill charges ₹38,070 more than the menu.
findings: Virgin Mojito: ₹4,800 for 2. The menu says ₹240 each, so ₹480. That's 10 times the menu price.
Hookah: ₹9,500 for 1. The menu says ₹950 each, so ₹950. That's 10 times the menu price.
Whisky 30 ml: ₹28,000 for 4. The menu says ₹700 each, so ₹2,800. That's 10 times the menu price.
Service charge, ₹4,262. In India a service charge is voluntary and can't be added by default. You can ask for it to be removed, and complain to the National Consumer Helpline on 1915.
The bill's QR pays rohit.k@okaxis, which doesn't carry the name Moonlit Terrace Cafe. Before you scan, check the name your UPI app shows. You can pay the business at the counter or by card.

rows.title: One line doubled
rows.plant: Two cold coffees billed at twice the menu price.
rows.headline: This bill charges ₹360 more than the menu.
findings: Cold Coffee: ₹720 for 2. The menu says ₹180 each, so ₹360. That's 2 times the menu price.

rows.title: Fifteen percent over
rows.plant: The veg platter billed at 520 against 450 on the menu.
rows.headline: This bill charges ₹70 more than the menu.
findings: Veg Platter: ₹520 for 1. The menu says ₹450 each, so ₹450. That's 16% over the menu price.

rows.title: A padded total
rows.plant: Every line is fair, but the printed total is 1,000 more than they add up to.
rows.headline: This bill's total doesn't add up.
findings: The total, ₹1,714, is ₹1,000 more than its own lines add up to.

rows.title: A ghost item
rows.plant: A 1,500 table reservation that is not on the menu.
rows.headline: Some of this bill isn't on the menu you photographed.
findings: Table reservation, ₹1,500, isn't on the menu you photographed. Ask what it is.

guessed.question: Who taught you to make coffee when you were growing up?
guessed.spoken: My grandmother taught me to make filter coffee in our kitchen when I was growing up.

guessed.question: What noise is it that makes your dog hide?
guessed.spoken: The pressure cooker whistle is the noise that makes my dog hide under the bed.

guessed.question: You mentioned your scooter, what do you call her?
guessed.spoken: I call my scooter Bijli because she zips through Bengaluru traffic so fast.

guessed.question: Where does your cat like to drink from?
guessed.spoken: My cat insists on drinking only from the leaking tap in my bathroom sink.

guessed.question: What do you play at celebrations?
guessed.spoken: I play the harmonium at family celebrations.

guessed.question: What happened on your first day at rowing?
guessed.spoken: On my first day at rowing, I tipped the boat sideways near Thevara and came home completely soaked.
